g.text: MinimalSafety controls U11 DRV8803 and K1/K2/K3 coil sinks.

g.desc: MinimalSafety controls U11 DRV8803 and K1/K2/K3 coil sinks.

g.text: GLOW_CMD and FUEL_CMD are separate; nENBL is the common hardware inhibit.

g.desc: GLOW_CMD and FUEL_CMD are separate; nENBL is the common hardware inhibit.

g.text: Motor PWM/purge remains separate. Switched contact and power ratings remain unqualified.

g.desc: Motor PWM/purge remains separate. Switched contact and power ratings remain unqualified.

g.text: Schematic assigned; PCB current/transient qualification OPEN. NO POWER / NO FIRE.

g.desc: Schematic assigned; PCB current/transient qualification OPEN. NO POWER / NO FIRE.

g.text: Schematic assigned; PCB current/transient qualification OPEN. NO POWER / NO FIRE.

g.desc: Schematic assigned; PCB current/transient qualification OPEN. NO POWER / NO FIRE.

g.text: J24 RESET ACTUAL PIN CONTRACT (NKK BB25AB-FA)

g.desc: J24 RESET ACTUAL PIN CONTRACT (NKK BB25AB-FA)

g.text: 1=EN_CHIP_PU NO; 2=GND COM; 3=unused NC. Hardware RESET grounds DevKit EN.

g.desc: 1=EN_CHIP_PU NO; 2=GND COM; 3=unused NC. Hardware RESET grounds DevKit EN.

g.text: 4=unused NO; 5=3V3 COM; 6=RESET_RELEASED NC, pulled LOW by R702 when open.

g.desc: 4=unused NO; 5=3V3 COM; 6=RESET_RELEASED NC, pulled LOW by R702 when open.

g.text: J25 is 3V3 ONLY, never a coil connection or external driven enable.

g.desc: J25 is 3V3 ONLY, never a coil connection or external driven enable.

g.text: Independent thermal contact specification and dynamic reset timing remain unqualified.

g.desc: Independent thermal contact specification and dynamic reset timing remain unqualified.

g.text: U9/U10 are MAX31856 for the two K-type thermocouples.

g.desc: U9/U10 are MAX31856 for the two K-type thermocouples.

g.text: Probe wiring, cold-junction error and fault thresholds still require verification.

g.desc: Probe wiring, cold-junction error and fault thresholds still require verification.

g.text: DRAFT: LM5013 5V is assigned to +5V_DEVKIT in this hierarchy. USB reverse-feed arbitration remains UNQUALIFIED. NO POWER.

g.desc: DRAFT: LM5013 5V is assigned to +5V_DEVKIT in this hierarchy. USB reverse-feed arbitration remains UNQUALIFIED. NO POWER.

g.text: R1: room-sensor pull-up; R2/R3: thermocouple CS pull-ups.

g.desc: R1: room-sensor pull-up; R2/R3: thermocouple CS pull-ups.

g.text: R7/R8: fan/PWM pulldowns. Safety pull resistors are inside MinimalSafety.

g.desc: R7/R8: fan/PWM pulldowns. Safety pull resistors are inside MinimalSafety.

g.text: GPIO21 MCU_PERMIT and GPIO41 ARM_PULSE are outputs; GPIO6 P24_PRESENT is INPUT ONLY.

g.desc: GPIO21 MCU_PERMIT and GPIO41 ARM_PULSE are outputs; GPIO6 P24_PRESENT is INPUT ONLY.

g.text: GPIO8 = TFT_DC; GPIO48 remains for the DevKit RGB LED. No RGB jumper removal.

g.desc: GPIO8 = TFT_DC; GPIO48 remains for the DevKit RGB LED. No RGB jumper removal.

g.text: GPIO42 / former SW_TRIP is unconnected. New firmware only after PCB completion.

g.desc: GPIO42 / former SW_TRIP is unconnected. New firmware only after PCB completion.

g.text: RELAY DRIVER DRAFT / NO POWER / NO FIRE

g.desc: RELAY DRIVER DRAFT / NO POWER / NO FIRE

g.text: U11 DRV8803PWPR: nENBL=HIGH disables all sinks.

g.desc: U11 DRV8803PWPR: nENBL=HIGH disables all sinks.

g.text: U2 Q -> SAFETY_OK -> U11 IN3. U2 /Q -> RELAY_DISABLE -> U11 nENBL.

g.desc: U2 Q -> SAFETY_OK -> U11 IN3. U2 /Q -> RELAY_DISABLE -> U11 nENBL.

g.text: GLOW_CMD -> U11 IN1; FUEL_CMD -> U11 IN2; commands remain separate.

g.desc: GLOW_CMD -> U11 IN1; FUEL_CMD -> U11 IN2; commands remain separate.

g.text: C21=100nF/100V; C22=330uF/63V. Driver limits, coil release, transient and thermal tests pending.

g.desc: C21=100nF/100V; C22=330uF/63V. Driver limits, coil release, transient and thermal tests pending.

g.text: The former U12/U14 gating and C23/C26 bypasses are removed, not silently bypassed.

g.desc: The former U12/U14 gating and C23/C26 bypasses are removed, not silently bypassed.

g.text: YD-ESP32-S3 N16R8; native hierarchical schematic candidate.

g.desc: YD-ESP32-S3 N16R8; native hierarchical schematic candidate.

g.text: DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO POWER / NO FIRE. PCB and firmware not yet synchronized.

g.desc: DRAFT / NOT FOR ORDER / NO POWER / NO FIRE. PCB and firmware not yet synchronized.

g.text: 5V conversion is on-board; USB/external power arbitration remains unqualified.

g.desc: 5V conversion is on-board; USB/external power arbitration remains unqualified.

g.text: J12: 1=3V3, 2=DQ, 3=GND. Never connect raw 24V to logic terminals.

g.desc: J12: 1=3V3, 2=DQ, 3=GND. Never connect raw 24V to logic terminals.

g.text: U1 watchdog; U2 asynchronous-clear latch; U6 three AND gates. U11 is the coil driver.

g.desc: U1 watchdog; U2 asynchronous-clear latch; U6 three AND gates. U11 is the coil driver.

g.text: U20 P24 presence monitor retained: USB can keep ESP32 alive during main-power loss.

g.desc: U20 P24 presence monitor retained: USB can keep ESP32 alive during main-power loss.

g.text: Return of any permission does not itself re-arm the latch; require a fresh ARM_PULSE.

g.desc: Return of any permission does not itself re-arm the latch; require a fresh ARM_PULSE.

g.text: The majority of process protections belongs to the ESP32 state machine, not extra logic ICs.

g.desc: The majority of process protections belongs to the ESP32 state machine, not extra logic ICs.

g.desc: TFT CABLE HARWIN M20-9960845 RA THT
